payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear demonstration that RNNs with arbitrary precision are computationally powerful enough to simulate pushdown automata (PDAs).

claims.text: RNNs with one hidden layer and ReLU activation, when allowed arbitrary precision, are at least as computationally powerful as pushdown automata.
Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) can also be shown to be at least as powerful as pushdown automata when infinite precision and edge weights are allowed.
